items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] John, Jerry Wexler, or Lou Chud, something like that? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, no. They were, they were, they were more, well, Chud was a, was an eternal cynic. But, but Wexler was, you know, New York, Jew turned atheist.

ctx.x: And it had to be, it had to be entirely in what they heard, since they weren't going to be seeing anything, hearing, and feeling any ambience, smelling any, whatever, you know. And, and, and, and he was correct, of course. So, so, so, so. I mean, who was?
John, Jerry Wexler, or Lou Chud, something like that?

No, no, no. They were, they were, they were more, well, Chud was a, was an eternal cynic. But, but Wexler was, you know, New York, Jew turned atheist. And, and hard, sharp, experienced, you know, all of the things Jerry Wexler is.
